module_summary: Counting Bloom filter: three hash blocks map lookup/increment/decrement data to one-hot bucket indicators driving per-bucket up/down counters, plus a total-item counter and status flags.

anchors.name: look_data_i
anchors.why: Lookup data hashed to test set membership.

anchors.name: look_valid_o
anchors.why: Membership result: all hashed buckets of lookup data are occupied.

anchors.name: incr_data_i
anchors.why: Data to add to the set, hashed into incr_ind.

anchors.name: incr_valid_i
anchors.why: Add-member command enabling bucket increments and total counter.

anchors.name: decr_data_i
anchors.why: Data to remove from the set, hashed into decr_ind.

anchors.name: decr_valid_i
anchors.why: Remove-member command selecting count-down for buckets and total counter.

anchors.name: look_ind
anchors.why: One-hot bucket indicator vector of lookup data hashes.

anchors.name: incr_ind
anchors.why: Bucket indicator vector for increment data.

anchors.name: decr_ind
anchors.why: Bucket indicator vector for decrement data.

anchors.name: bucket_en
anchors.why: Per-bucket counter enable decoded from incr/decr valid and indicators.

anchors.name: bucket_down
anchors.why: Per-bucket count direction, down on decrement indicators.

anchors.name: gen_buckets[*].bucket_content
anchors.why: Per-bucket counter value forming the counting Bloom filter array.

anchors.name: bucket_occupied
anchors.why: Nonzero-bucket vector used for membership check and empty flag.

anchors.name: data_in_bucket
anchors.why: Lookup indicators masked by occupied buckets for membership compare.

anchors.name: cnt_en
anchors.why: Enables total item counter when exactly one of incr/decr is valid.

anchors.name: filter_usage_o
anchors.why: Total item count output from i_tot_count.

anchors.name: filter_error_o
anchors.why: Bucket or total counter overflow error flag.

groups.name: hash_units
groups.description: Three hash blocks mapping lookup/incr/decr data to bucket indicators.

groups.name: bucket_control
groups.description: Decodes incr/decr valid into per-bucket enable and direction.

groups.name: bucket_counters
groups.description: Array of per-bucket up/down counters with occupancy/full/empty decode.

groups.name: membership_lookup
groups.description: Checks all lookup-hashed buckets occupied to produce look_valid_o.

groups.name: total_counter
groups.description: Counts items currently in the filter.

groups.name: status_flags
groups.description: Reduces bucket flags into full, empty and error outputs.
